Package net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.sampler

Class PASamplerVoice

java.lang.Object
net.paulhertz.pixelaudio.sampler.PASamplerVoice
public class PASamplerVoice extends Object
PASamplerVoice - a single playback "voice" reading from a shared mono buffer. Each voice handles: - playback position and pitch - per-voice amplitude and pan - one independent SimpleADSR envelope (sample-accurate) - optional wrap-around reads for finite events near the buffer end - optional zero-crossing start and micro-fade-in Voices can be smoothly released and are recycled once the envelope finishes.
